render_rules.keyframe: Anima 1280x704. Make 4 candidates per shot and pick one by token fidelity (bob with flipped ends, mole under HER right eye, red neckerchief, his hair over his eyes) before any video is generated. Keyframe negative: worst quality, low quality, text, watermark, signature, logo, silhouette, extra fingers, bad hands, deformed, nsfw.
render_rules.video: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B Turbo i2v, 1280x704, 24 fps. Frames are 4n+1: 2.0 s = 49, 3.5 s = 85, 5.0 s = 121.
render_rules.finish: Scale 1280x704 to 1964x1080 (Lanczos plus a light line sharpen), then center-crop to 1920x1080. Retimes below 1.0x use optical-flow interpolation (OpenCV DIS) on CPU. Two-bar holds use all 121 frames at 0.85x (5.04 s fills 5.93 s): intended slow motion, no chain needed.
render_rules.letterbox: Present-time shots are 2.39:1 (138 px bars). In present shots the Chinese line sits in the lower bar. The bars open on 171.05; everything after 172.54 is 16:9. Memory shots are always 16:9.
render_rules.grade: One unified pass after assembly. Per-world look: memory is warm and high-key with halation; present is lit only by practicals; dawn has horizontal light. 35 mm grain at 0.03 and gate weave of 0.5 px. Heat-haze amplitude works as a memory meter: 0 in honest reality, up to 2% of frame height in memory and in the climax.
render_rules.reflection_device: At night, reflective surfaces (CRT glass, dark window, glass of water, puddles, curve mirror) show last summer's noon. A noon clip that is already in this list is masked into the reflective area of a locked-off or slow night plate.
render_rules.reuse: Composite shots and reflection inserts reuse only clips listed here, by shot id and seconds. There are no hidden extra plates.
render_rules.three_js: No visible 3D geometry in MV-A, so the painted look stays consistent. three.js is used at most as an optical helper: the CRT glass curvature and specular pass, and the plane for the final horizon flip.
render_rules.photosensitivity: No more than 3 large luminance flashes per second (strobe, fireworks, crossing lamps).
render_rules.generation_order: Generate bridge2, chorus3, outro_hook and outro first (the payoff), then the rest. One clip of the 58-clip budget is held in reserve.
